placements.why: All three segments thematically support the narrative that the product captures decisions at the moment of consensus. src-1 reports the async decision widget shipped — the implementation of that capture. src-3 names the Zephyr integration as the enabler of cross-platform zero-effort capture, the mechanism by which consensus is intercepted. src-2's velocity metric is position-grain evidence that the approach works, not a leaf of its own (rule 2). No existing leaf other than Narrative_DecisionCaptureAtConsensus plausibly holds this theme: Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning is about competitive framing, not delivery; Narrative_DecisionsEvaporate is the problem narrative, not the solution.
